title: Terrain feature parameters (fixed before any terrain value is computed)
basis: Design choices for Phase 2, taken from common practice and the existing V0.4 terrain code; no terrain value, sample, feature or model existed.

features_terrain.reason: flow_accumulation_cells and catchment_area_m2 are the same quantity (area = cells x 900 m2); one log10 catchment area is kept.

value.crs_rule: native projected CRS of the inventory (UTM zone of its centroid)
value.resampling: bilinear from NASADEM 1 arc-second to the 30 m UTM grid; NASADEM nodata -32768 becomes NaN
value.grid_origin: multiples of 30 m in the working CRS
value.slope_aspect: preslide.terrain.derivatives (central differences; aspect = downslope azimuth clockwise from grid north; meridian convergence < 2 degrees ignored)
value.curvature_tri: preslide.v04.terrain.curvatures (Zevenbergen-Thorne profile/plan curvature in 1/100 m, mean absolute neighbour difference)
value.hydrology: preslide.v04.terrain.fill_depressions (Planchon-Darboux) and flow_accumulation (D8) on the block window; cells whose catchment touches the window edge are truncated and their catchment features are NaN
value.drainage_distance: Euclidean distance to the nearest cell with catchment >= channel_threshold_m2 inside the window; NaN if none
value.nan_policy: NaN means not computable and is never imputed in the feature tables; counts by feature and reason are reported. Models that cannot take NaN impute inside the training fold only (Phase 4 amendment).
value.dem_date_rule: every DEM source must have acquisition_end strictly before the earliest positive event date of the dataset; checked in code before any value is computed

terrain.reason: The registration listed the feature names but not their parameters. They are fixed here before any terrain value exists.

preconditions: registration present; no samples, features or models existed
